name: Chromium Throne
rules: Atom owns command routing and durable mission state.
Chromium Throne is an add-on, never the command authority.
The user never has to operate a ChatGPT terminal to advance a mission.
ChatGPT may be selected by Atom as a worker but is not a required user-facing surface.
All commands produce durable receipts or explicit blocked states.
Offline commands queue locally and are replayed when Atom becomes reachable.
